speaker: Doctor
text: Hello, I am Dr. Agent. I see you are a newborn with increasing yellow discoloration of the eyes and skin; to begin my assessment, how many hours after birth did this jaundice first become noticeable?

speaker: Patient
text: 2-week-old female newborn. The patient has been experiencing increasing yellow discoloration of her eyes and skin for 2 days. She was born at 39 weeks' gestation, initially weighed 3066 g and now weighs 3200 g. The patient is exclusively breastfed.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Breast Milk Jaundice. The onset at two weeks of life in a 39-week gestation infant who is exclusively breastfed, with stable weight gain, is classic for this benign condition. I will confirm your bilirubin levels to ensure they are safe for discharge.
